about: ROUTE R5, THE POLAR TRAIL (One World phase 4.1, the owner's north routes thread, 2026-11-17): a trail from the Mountains' ridge (the Lodge's room; seam ow_v_m13_m22) east and north across the tundra to the North Pole's west wall (seam ow_v_0_m27). 36 plots, ONE room `site_ow_r5` since ONE WORLD PHASE 5 (2026-11-17, mondo: smaller than Disaster City = one room, never ask): bake it whole, `node bake-route.js R5`. It was two rooms (`site_ow_r5_0_17`, `site_ow_r5_18_35`, by the 30-plot number; both retired into site_ow_r5), with a loading card in the middle of the tundra. It replaces the Pass Gate doors (`pass`) that jumped from the Lodge to the Pole. PLACES (ow-places.js, every name an idea of Claude's): the page gives a frozen lake and a mountain hut; the rest are the kit's picks by the ground.
